items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: And I loved playing with him... That rhythm section was, with, with Sam Price, Pop Foster, and Baby Dogs.

ctx.x: And I loved playing with him, and he, the way he could make a press roll swing on the drums was just terrific. Yeah. Yeah. That rhythm section was, with, with Sam Price, Pop Foster, and Baby Dogs. That upset, uh, that upset the Armstrong All-Stars.

items.title: Bob Wilber Interview, 1961-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Baby Dogs is over there, and Pops Foster.

ctx.x: And Baby Dogs is over there, and Pops Foster. Yeah.
Naturally, Mes, he wanted Mes to be one of the leaders, and Louie had the other band.
